all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Oakland, CA, USA
long_description: AnnieCannons (AC) is a 501(c)3 nonprofit dedicated to training survivors of human trafficking and gender-based violence to be programmers, giving them both the economic and technological empowerment to invent solutions to overcome the hardships they have survived, and the capacity to support themselves and their families.
name: AnnieCannons
one_liner: Connecting Survivors to Careers in Tech
